title: Sacrificial Stones

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Sacrificial Stones are a permanent structure where the Valkyries ferry slain Vikings into Valheim. It is always located in the very center of the world map, and is set with seven individual large stones placed around a small circular stone foundation.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: When the player finds any of the Forsaken Altars and obtains the trophy of a defeated boss, they can return to the Sacrificial Stones and hang the trophy on its respective stone, which allows them to activate a special Forsaken power. Forsaken powers can be used infinitely, but each has a cooldown period between uses.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
Around the Sacrificial Stones is an invisible zone of 26-meter diameter (13-meter radius), in which you cannot build any structures or make changes to the terrain. If you move your cursor into the area, the structure or the indicator will turn red. If you then try to place something, the following message is displayed:
"A mystical force in this area stops you."

full_text:
Sacrificial Stones

Type: Structure | Location: Meadows

Introduction. The Sacrificial Stones are a permanent structure where the Valkyries ferry slain Vikings into Valheim. It is always located in the very center of the world map, and is set with seven individual large stones placed around a small circular stone foundation.

Usage. When the player finds any of the Forsaken Altars and obtains the trophy of a defeated boss, they can return to the Sacrificial Stones and hang the trophy on its respective stone, which allows them to activate a special Forsaken power. Forsaken powers can be used infinitely, but each has a cooldown period between uses.

Notes. Around the Sacrificial Stones is an invisible zone of 26-meter diameter (13-meter radius), in which you cannot build any structures or make changes to the terrain. If you move your cursor into the area, the structure or the indicator will turn red. If you then try to place something, the following message is displayed:
"A mystical force in this area stops you."
